title_ru: AI-Lover — матрица слоев населения и усиления замкнутого AI-feedback loop

method.important: All inputs are synthetic scenario parameters chosen to stress-test mechanisms, not measured population means or addiction prevalence.

cohorts.canonical_description: General adult synthetic control with no assumed pre-existing dependence or closed-worldview state.
Religious believer with preserved question freedom, outside community, counterevidence access and no assumed coercive or closed-worldview state.
cohorts.note: Religion itself receives zero causal multiplier.

cohorts.canonical_description: State-based closed-worldview cohort: high conviction + low counterevidence + identity fusion/closed information ecology. Applies symmetrically to religious, anti-religious, political, conspiratorial or other ideologies.
cohorts.note: Do not infer this state from religion or group membership.

cohorts.canonical_description: Synthetic state with an established substance-related reinforcement pattern or elevated relapse vulnerability; AI is tested only as a possible amplifier/cue organizer, not as a cause of the substance disorder.
cohorts.note: No individual clinical diagnosis is inferred.

cohorts.canonical_description: Synthetic state with existing loss-of-control around a repetitive non-substance behavior such as gambling, gaming or problematic social-media use.
cohorts.note: Highest modeled ABLI among requested strata because the reinforcement architecture overlaps most directly.

cohorts.canonical_description: Synthetic state defined by low offline support, social isolation or exclusion. Social marginalization itself is not pathology.
cohorts.note: Protection focus: increase human connection and choice space, not engagement extraction.

cohorts.canonical_description: Highly educated/knowledge-work cohort with substantial AI utility and domain reasoning load.
cohorts.note: Primary modeled lane is cognitive delegation/overreliance rather than emotional dependence.

cohorts.canonical_description: Scientific/technical professionals using AI for research, coding, synthesis or evaluation.
cohorts.note: Expertise alone receives no protective bonus; explicit source checking, replication and peer review provide the protection.

cross_cutting_risk_modifiers_from_curren: memory/personalization that preserves a single perspective
cross_cutting_protective_modifiers: ability to stop without distress or functional impairment

interpretation.religion_control_result: RELIGIOUS_BELIEF_OPEN_QUESTION_CONTROL is intentionally approximately equal to GENERAL_ADULT_CONTROL. The model assigns no addiction multiplier to ordinary faith.
interpretation.expert_result: High-education and scientific cohorts remain near control in emotional-loop risk but retain a distinct cognitive-overreliance lane. Verification workflow, not social status, is the protective mechanism.
interpretation.claim_ceiling: These values rank synthetic scenarios inside the JANUS model. They must not be quoted as measured addiction rates for real groups.

topa_required_falsifiers: replace identity labels with matched state variables and test whether explanatory power is preserved
hold usage constant and vary personalization
hold personalization constant and vary sycophancy
hold content topic constant and vary recommendation diversity
match paid/free users on pre-subscription engagement
measure functional impairment and loss of control separately from frequency
preregister cohort hypotheses before observing outcomes
seal: GROUP NAME IS NOT A CAUSE. MECHANISM OR IT DOES NOT ENTER THE MODEL.
